_comment: Word ceilings for the standing docs every agent loads. Counted with `wc -w`
semantics over the whole file; see scripts/check-doc-budgets.mjs.
AGENTS.md is the entry point every session reads; docs/conventions.md is the
standing-rules doc it points at (split out of docs/specs/development.md).
docs/architecture.md and docs/security.md are reference docs, not standing
rules, so they are deliberately not budgeted: a doc where every row is a fact
Each ceiling is the measured size when the gate landed plus about 5% headroom.
Growth past it has to be argued for in the change that raises it, not absorbed.
